# Development Guidelines

- Repo slug must remain universal-fasion-size.
- Backend is Python 3.12, FastAPI and Pydantic.
- Do not replace functional APIs with mock placeholders.
- No unverified retailer charts or fabricated customer accuracy statements.
- A sizing score is a heuristic, not a probability.
- Never claim single-photo body measurements provide exact real-world dimensions without calibration.
- Protect privacy: do not add persistent body measurements or image uploads without explicit consent and review.
- Keep the animation responsive, accessible and reduced-motion compatible.
- Cover functionality changes with tests and update README, CHANGELOG, PROJECT_CONTEXT and dated project memory.
- Do not claim GitHub automatic Vercel deployment while Git integration is disconnected.
- No unattended pushes or releases: explicit user intent is required.
